svg.title: Manta Bot architecture: configured drive, direct LiDAR and disabled camera
svg.desc: GamepadCmdVel and Flask publish TwistStamped on /cmd_vel. ros2_control at 50 Hz uses the C++ MantaHardware plugin to send RPM commands over /dev/ttyAMA0 at 115200 baud to the Mega parser and nominal 50 Hz local PI loop. Encoders close only the Mega loop. The plugin mirrors commands and integrates positions, so ROS odometry is command-derived. Signed RPM telemetry at 5 Hz is emitted but unused. LiDAR connects directly to Pi SLAM. Camera console scripts are commented out. Drive and SLAM launches require separate composition.
svg.text: Manta Bot | Layered architecture
Source-configured wiring, not proof of running processes. LiDAR and camera connect directly to the Pi, not through Mega.
Drive | Raspberry Pi to Arduino Mega
Perception and web services | Raspberry Pi
GamepadCmdVel
Movement/controller.py; /dev/input/js0
Installed as gamepad_controller
Manual start, not launched automatically
Flask UI | UI_app.py
Browser drive requests on HTTP 5000
TwistStamped /cmd_vel publisher
No sensor subscriptions; placeholders
ROS 2 / DDS: /cmd_vel (TwistStamped)
diff_drive_controller | ros2_control
controller_manager configured at 50 Hz; wheel targets in rad/s
Radius 0.040 m; separation 0.265 m; stamped-command timeout 0.5 s
/diff_drive_controller/odom and odom to base_footprint TF: command-derived
Wheel velocity command interfaces
C++ manta_hardware/MantaHardware
write(): rad/s to RPM; /dev/ttyAMA0 at 115200 baud
read(): velocity = command; position += velocity × elapsed period
NOT measured feedback: read_status() is unused.
ROS wheel states and controller odometry assume commanded motion.
UART ASCII: V:leftRPM,rightRPM + newline
VS on plugin activation / deactivation
Mega | main.cpp to closed_loop.cpp and pid.cpp
Line parser sets wheel targets; local PI nominally 50 Hz with actual elapsed dt
Watchdog: silence >500 ms stops outputs; VS / ESTOP are not latched
Encoders A/B: D18/19 and D20/21; CHANGE ISRs on D18 and D20
748 counts per wheel revolution = 11 × 2 × 34; deltas yield signed RPM
Cooperative loop, not hard real-time; no guaranteed physical braking
motor_control: PWM D2/D7
Direction D3-D6
Local encoder feedback
Two H-bridge channels to two geared motors
Two quadrature encoders; source does not establish the driver board count.
Unused return path: signed RPM1/RPM2 telemetry emitted at 5 Hz.
SS direct print is commented out; no measured RPM reaches plugin read().
Real RPLiDAR | direct Pi serial connection
/dev/ttyUSB0 to rplidar_ros/rplidar_composition
Publishes /scan (LaserScan), header frame_id: laser_frame
/scan and robot TF
Async SLAM Toolbox | async_slam_toolbox_node
Publishes /map and map to odom TF; requires the drive TF chain
LiDAR scans do not pass through Mega.
Robot transforms | URDF and robot_state_publisher
Fixed joints from URDF; wheel joints from /joint_states
joint_state_broadcaster uses the plugin's command-derived states.
Camera source only | console scripts commented in setup.py
camera_publisher.py: OpenCV capture directly on Pi
Not enabled by either launch
/image_raw (Image)
yolo26_ros2.py | source-only detector
Outputs /detections and /image_annotated/compressed
Detection2DArray and CompressedImage
/image_annotated/compressed
stream.py | separate HTTP 9091 endpoint to browser
Subscribes to compressed annotation; source-only server
Not a Flask UI sensor subscription
Camera scripts exist in source but their console entry points are disabled.
Dashed purple boxes and arrows are not configured launch flow.
Deployment boundary | no complete robot launch
Compose diff_drive.launch.py (controllers and robot_state_publisher) with slam.launch.py (LiDAR, SLAM activation and Flask UI).
GamepadCmdVel needs a separate start. Camera remains source-only. Neither launch alone starts the complete drive and mapping system.
Stops set PWM to zero and direction pins low; these are software stop actions, not a latched safety or braking guarantee.
Legend | status is encoded by line style and explicit labels
Solid blue: configured flow
Long dashed purple: disabled camera
Short dashed amber: unused telemetry
